name: Fuzhi 1
summary: Fuzhi 1 is Fuwei Intelligent’s wheeled humanoid robot for industrial handling and assembly. It combines two articulated arms and dexterous hands with a folding lift structure and a mobile base. Fuwei describes RGB-D vision, visual workflow programming and model-based task planning for automotive, electronics, logistics, medical, energy and machining environments. It is publicly documented in the manufacturer’s product catalog; current delivery availability has not been independently confirmed.
